market_question: Will the US acquire part of Greenland in 2026?
reasoning: The US is not actively pursuing acquisition of Greenland; both Denmark and Greenland have firmly rejected sale. The resolution criteria require a binding agreement on sovereignty or exclusive jurisdictional control, a very high bar that is far from current reality. With only two years left and no negotiations, the probability is minimal.
evidence_points: Greenlandic and Danish officials have repeatedly stated Greenland is not for sale.
No ongoing negotiations or binding proposals for US acquisition exist.
Even a military base expansion would fall short of exclusive jurisdiction as defined in the rules.
